components.name: Primary button
components.description: Native action used by the click counter; script enables it after initialization.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--paper, #faf8f3); background: var(--accent, #235c42); font: 600 1rem/1.65 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #17442f); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #235c42); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Shared header
components.description: Wrapping header with the Education home link and supporting text.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem 2rem; padding: 1.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #cbd2c8); color: var(--muted, #53665c); font: 0.9rem/1.65 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-home { color: var(--accent, #235c42); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; } .ds-home:hover { color: var(--accent-hover, #17442f); } .ds-home:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #235c42); outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview: A small, text-led Hello World page serves as a build, publishing, and JavaScript smoke test. Cream paper, green ink, and serif headings give the current scaffold a quiet, readable appearance; this records the shipped interface rather than establishing a larger brand.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper background and one green accent.
Serif headings paired with system sans-serif text.
Responsive shared header and footer, with a native counter button.
No imagery or animated transitions in the current page.
dos: Do use the shared palette, layout, and typography recorded here when maintaining the scaffold.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the native button's accessible status feedback.
donts: Don't describe unimplemented learning-page features as part of this design system.
